title: Discussion Paper on Charges in Payment Systems (40 questions on UPI/IMPS/NEFT/card charges)
outcome_note: Submissions were never published by RBI; commenters self-published (NASSCOM's full submission is public by its own choice). The paper set off the UPI-charges debate; the finance ministry publicly denied any plan to charge UPI, and the merchant-discount-rate question resurfaced in later rule-making.

title: Discussion Paper on Guidelines for Payment Gateways and Payment Aggregators
outcome_note: Final PA/PG directions followed in 2020; the comment record survives only because commenters like Vidhi published their own submissions, including its delegated-legislation objections on the PSS Act.

title: Consultation Paper on Review of Closing Auction Session, Market Timings and Settlement Methodologies for Derivative Contracts
outcome_note: SEBI's verified account reported 20,000 comments by 19:00 IST on the final submission day, 3 Oct 2026. Submissions and the regulator's response remain to be tracked.

title: Consultation Paper on Corporate Governance: secretarial compliance, auditors, related-party transactions
SEBI (Procedure for Making, Amending and Reviewing of Regulations) — formalised pre-legislative consultation
outcome_note: Board-approved procedure (18 Dec 2024) making structured pre-legislative consultation mandatory — the strongest transparency baseline among the six desks; the watch compares other regulators against it.

title: Public Consultation Paper on Recalibrating Economics of Insurance Distribution (commissions, EoM, Bima Sugam, Public Insurance Registry)
outcome_note: Live watch: who comments on distribution economics (insurers, banks-as-banca partners, brokers, web aggregators) and whether IRDAI publishes a response statement when the final rules land.

title: Draft framework for regulation-making and public consultation under the Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha (Amendment of Insurance Laws) Act 2025
outcome_note: If notified as proposed: minimum 21-day comment windows, and a published general statement of response to comments by notification date — plus a fresh consultation round when final rules differ substantially from drafts.

title: Discussion Paper: amendments to CIRP, Liquidation and Personal Guarantor Regulations
outcome_note: Comments submitted through the IBBI website's Public Comments section.
